title: Press_Anchor re-gate breaks the ESC+right+left chord: swallow latch stays set where the old handle_input cleared it, suppressing the follow-up release's click-select
detail: Old chord re-anchor reset swallow to false after the ESC/right cancel (drag already cleared). The new gate suppresses Press_Anchor on ESC frames, leaving swallow=true, so the next release's click-select (5.5) never fires — a mouse-path delta vs handle_input, delta-introduced.
recommended_fix: Emit Press_Anchor on the chord whenever the queued Cancel's post-state leaves no was_dragging re-latch: `has_left && (placing_eff >= 0 || esc_cancelled || (esc_deselect && !inp.drag.active))` — restores the old swallow=false after every ESC/right+left chord.

title: mouse_map doc comment now false: the B1 fix mutates sel_pipe/sel_node at map time, contradicting the stated 'mutates only (press, press_swallowed)' contract
detail: The B1 map-time deselect mutates sel_pipe/sel_node, contradicting the file's stated contract that the mapping touches only press/press_swallowed. The comment now misdescribes the code and licenses further map-time state writes.
recommended_fix: Update the mouse_map doc comment to include the ESC-deselect selection clear among the mapping's map-time mutations.
